scientific_integrity: The all-parameter proof is structural. Exact finite adjacency, domination and mod-two homology computations corroborate only the tested instances. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Natural S_n label-permutation action only; exact fixed-point homotopy types for each subgroup but no compatibility of fixed-point inclusion maps or full equivariant type. The proof uses the exact orbit graph collapse and previously published ordinary wedge counts. Unindexed prior work may overlap.
title: Subgroup-fixed homotopy of complete-graph generalized Mycielskians
